metaDescription: Norwich Terrier vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Norwich Terrier boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Norwich Terrier social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Norwich Terrier exposure.
Weight range 11-12 lb (5 kg) and grooming needs (Wire coat care.) belong in the same Norwich Terrier household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Norwich Terrier is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Norwich Terrier appointments.
After the Norwich Terrier puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Norwich Terrier shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or upper airway syndrome risk worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Norwich Terrier make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Norwich Terrier antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Norwich Terrier dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small dog.
Reset the Norwich Terrier reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Norwich Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Norwich Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Norwich Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Norwich Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as upper airway syndrome risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
